flags.sourceSentence: At the end of the initial term, and at the end of each term thereafter, your membership renews automatically for a further twelve (12) month term at the then-current rate.
flags.consequence: Missing the cancellation deadline commits the signer to a further full 12-month term at whatever rate is then current, which could be higher than the rate they signed at.

flags.sourceSentence: Notice delivered after that day takes effect at the end of the term that follows, and the dues for the intervening term remain payable in full.
flags.consequence: A cancellation notice that arrives even one day late does not take effect until the end of the following 12-month term, and the signer owes the full dues for that entire intervening term.

flags.sourceSentence: A membership that has been suspended, frozen or placed on medical hold continues to renew on its original schedule.
flags.consequence: A membership that is suspended, frozen or on medical hold keeps renewing on its original schedule, so the signer can keep owing 12-month terms — and be exposed to the late-notice rule above — for a period they cannot use.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may amend the Club Rules, the Schedule of Fees, the hours of operation, the class timetable and the terms of this Agreement at any time by posting the amended version at the club or on the Meridian website, and the amended version applies to you from the date it is posted.
flags.consequence: Meridian can change the Club Rules, the Schedule of Fees, the hours, the timetable and the terms of this Agreement itself at any time, with the changes binding from the date of posting, and the signer is treated as having accepted them just by continuing to use the facility — with no cap on what can be changed and no right to leave without penalty stated.

flags.sourceSentence: Your continued use of any facility after an amended version is posted is your acceptance of it.
flags.consequence: Continuing to use the facility after an amendment is posted is treated as the signer's acceptance of it, so changes — including to fees and core terms — bind them without a signature.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian is not liable for indirect, incidental, consequential or punitive damages, for lost income or lost business opportunity, or for loss of or damage to property brought onto club premises, including property left in a locker.
flags.consequence: The signer loses any right to recover for lost, stolen or damaged personal property — including items left in a locker — and Meridian's total liability for any claim, including negligence, is capped at only the dues and fees paid in the prior 12 months, with no recovery for lost income or consequential loss.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify, defend and hold harmless Meridian and its ofﬁcers, employees, instructors and contractors against any claim, demand, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable legal fees, that is brought by a third party and arises out of your use of the facilities, your conduct on club premises, the conduct of a guest you bring, or any service you provide to another member.
flags.consequence: The signer must pay, defend and indemnify Meridian for third-party claims arising from their own use of the facilities, their conduct, their guest's conduct, or any service they provide to another member — an open-ended obligation that includes Meridian's legal fees, with Meridian choosing the lawyer and the signer unable to settle without Meridian's written consent.

flags.sourceSentence: For twelve (12) months after your Program candidacy ends for any reason, you will not teach, coach or deliver group ﬁtness instruction or personal training, whether as an employee, as a contractor or on your own account, at any facility within ﬁfteen (15) miles of a Meridian location at which you taught or trained.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after their Program candidacy ends for any reason — including ending it themselves or Meridian ending it — the signer cannot teach, coach or deliver group fitness or personal training, as employee, contractor or on their own account, at any facility within 15 miles of any Meridian location where they taught or trained, and cannot solicit Meridian members or candidates for outside instruction.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute, claim or controversy between you and Meridian arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or the Program will be resolved by ﬁnal and binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer arbitration rules, and you and Meridian each waive any right to a trial by jury and any right to bring or participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to a jury trial and to bring or join any class, collective or representative action against Meridian; disputes go to a single arbitrator whose award is final. A 30-day opt-out is available, but only if the signer delivers written notice to the Section 11 address within 30 days of first accepting the Agreement.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may adjust dues once in any twelve (12) month period by the greater of six percent (6%)  or the increase in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers over the preceding twelve months, on thirty (30) days notice to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: Dues can be raised once every 12 months by the greater of 6% or CPI on 30 days' email notice, and the increase takes effect without the signer's agreement; over a 12-month term this could add at least 6% to every monthly payment.

flags.sourceSentence: Dues not received within ten (10) days of the draw date incur the late charge set out in the Schedule of Fees then in effect, which is posted at the Member Services desk and on the Meridian website and forms part of this Agreement.
flags.consequence: Late payments trigger a late charge whose amount is not stated in this document but sits in a Schedule of Fees posted elsewhere and 'then in effect', so the figure can change and is not visible in what the signer is given to sign; similar unbounded-in-this-document charges apply for returned payments, keycard replacement and account reinstatement.

flags.sourceSentence: Candidates are expected to complete sixty (60) supervised teaching hours in each Program year, and a candidate who falls short may be held back a year at Meridian’s discretion.
flags.consequence: If the signer completes fewer than 60 supervised teaching hours in a Program year, Meridian can hold them back a year at its discretion, which in practice means another year of annual tuition under the renewal clause before certification can be completed.

flags.sourceSentence: Program enrolment renews on each anniversary of your Program start date at the then-current tuition.
flags.consequence: Program tuition renews automatically each anniversary at the then-current rate, which may be higher than the rate the signer enrolled at; the signer must give written notice at least 90 days before the anniversary to stop it, and even then the candidacy only closes at the end of the running Program year.

flags.sourceSentence: You authorise Meridian to draw all dues, tuition and charges from the payment method on your account until this Agreement has ended and your balance is nil.
flags.consequence: The signer authorises Meridian to keep drawing dues, tuition and charges from the payment method on file until the Agreement has ended and the balance is nil, so recurring charges continue automatically unless the signer affirmatively ends the Agreement and clears the balance.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Plot Holder gives notice, no refund is due, and the Plot Holder may harvest whatever is ready before the notice period runs out.
flags.consequence: If the Plot Holder ends the licence early, they lose the unused portion of the $45 season fee, even for months they will not be using the plot.

flags.sourceSentence: Anything left after 15 December becomes the Association’s to keep or to clear.
flags.consequence: Any of the Plot Holder's canes, netting, frames or other items still on the plot after 15 December 2027 becomes the Association's property, to keep or throw away, with no compensation.

flags.sourceSentence: We may revise the fee for any plan, and a revised fee applies to you from the start of the first Billing Period that begins more than thirty (30) days after we send notice of the revision to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: The operator can raise the subscription fee at any time, and the new fee applies automatically from the start of the first Billing Period beginning more than 30 days after an email notice — the signer's only option is to cancel before that period starts.

flags.sourceSentence: On an annual plan the deadline to cancel is the day that falls thirty (30) days before the anniversary of the date you first subscribed, and where no cancellation is received by that day the term extends by a further twelve (12) months at the annual fee then in effect.
flags.consequence: On an annual plan, missing the cancellation deadline — 30 days before the subscription anniversary — automatically commits the signer to another full 12-month term at whatever the annual fee then is, with no fresh signature.

flags.sourceSentence: We may amend these terms, the pricing page and the Fee Schedule at any time, an amended version takes effect when we post it at northwindstudio.example/terms, and your continued use of the service after it is posted is your acceptance of the amended version.
flags.consequence: The operator can change any term of the agreement — including the pricing page and Fee Schedule — at any time, and the changes take effect merely by being posted on its website, with the signer's continued use treated as acceptance even if they never saw the posting.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Northwind harmless from any claim brought by a third party that relates to content you uploaded, exported or published through the service, including a claim that the content infringes a copyright, a trade mark or a right of privacy, and you will pay our reasonable legal costs of defending such a claim.
flags.consequence: The signer must pay Northwind's reasonable legal costs and cover any third-party claim connected to content they uploaded, exported or published — including copyright, trade mark or privacy claims — with no cap tied to what they paid for the service.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between you and Northwind arising out of these terms or out of your use of the service will be settled by binding arbitration before a single arbitrator under the consumer rules of a recognised arbitration body, and you agree to bring any claim only in your individual capacity and not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, collective or representative proceeding.
flags.consequence: Any dispute — including claims over lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — must go to individual binding arbitration with a final award, and the signer gives up the ability to join a class, collective or representative proceeding; only qualifying small-claims cases can go to court.

flags.sourceSentence: Where a payment is not collected on its due date, interest accrues on the unpaid amount at one and one half percent (1.5%) per month from the due date until payment is received, and an account suspended for non-payment is subject to the reactivation charge published in the Fee Schedule on the Northwind support site.
flags.consequence: If a payment fails — including because a stored card has merely expired — interest of 1.5% per month accrues on the unpaid amount until paid, and a suspended account can only be reactivated on payment of a charge whose amount is set in a Fee Schedule the signer was not given.

flags.sourceSentence: Your subscription continues from one Billing Period into the next without further action by either of us, and we bill the plan fee then in effect on the first day of each new Billing Period.
flags.consequence: The subscription renews automatically each Billing Period without any fresh action, and the signer must cancel by the day before the period ends on a monthly plan or the fee for the new period is charged and kept.

flags.sourceSentence: Where availability in a calendar month falls below that figure, your remedy is the service credit set out in the Service Credit Policy and nothing further.
flags.consequence: If downtime in a month falls below the 99.5% target, the signer's only remedy is whatever credit the Service Credit Policy allows — a document not supplied — with no refund or other compensation beyond it, even for lost work or a failed export.

flags.sourceSentence: Northwind’s aggregate liability to you for every claim relating to the service, whether framed in contract, in tort, in warranty or otherwise — and including any claim arising from lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — will not exceed the amount you actually paid us under Section 2 for the Billing Period in which the claim arose.
flags.consequence: Northwind's total liability for everything relating to the service — including lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — is capped at the amount paid for the single Billing Period in which the claim arose, which on a monthly plan could be one month's fee.

flags.sourceSentence: You may not share your credentials with anyone else, and an account we believe is being used by more than one person may be suspended while we ask you about it.
flags.consequence: Northwind can suspend the signer's account, cutting off access to their files and work, based on its own belief that more than one person is using the credentials, and the text sets no time limit on how long the suspension lasts while it 'asks you about it'.

flags.sourceSentence: A cancellation made on or after the first day of a Billing Period takes effect at the end of that Billing Period, and the fee already collected for it is not refunded.
flags.consequence: If the signer cancels on or after the first day of a Billing Period, the fee for that whole period is charged and not refunded, even though the signer cancels immediately.

flags.sourceSentence: Ardent may introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, handbook provision, benefit plan or term of employment described in this letter at any time and without your agreement, and the version in force on the Ardent intranet governs from the date it is published there.
flags.consequence: Ardent can introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, benefit plan, or term of employment — including terms described in this offer — at any time without the signer's agreement, with the change taking effect simply by being published on the company intranet. There is no cap on changes, no advance-notice requirement, and no right for the signer to leave without penalty in response.

flags.sourceSentence: For a period of twelve (12) months following the last day of your employment, whether that employment ends at your choice or at ours, you will not provide services that are the same as or substantially similar to those you provided to Ardent, whether as an employee, a consultant, a contractor, an adviser or a principal, to any business that develops, manufactures or sells a product within the Restricted Field as that term is defined in Exhibit B to this letter.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after employment ends — whether the signer quits or is fired — they cannot work in any capacity for any business in the Restricted Field (defined in Exhibit B, which was not provided), and cannot solicit Ardent employees or approach Ardent customers, distributors or contract manufacturers they dealt with. This could block the signer from working in their own speciality for a year, and the geographic and field scope is set in a document the signer has not supplied.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify Ardent and hold it harmless against any claim, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable attorney fees, that arises out of a breach by you of Section 4 or Section 5 of this letter, or out of a claim by a former employer that your employment with Ardent breaches an obligation you owe to them.
flags.consequence: The signer must reimburse Ardent for any claim, loss, liability or expense, including attorney fees, arising from an alleged breach of the confidentiality/non-compete sections — or from a former employer's claim that hiring them breached an obligation to that employer. The amount is open-ended and uncapped.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Ardent each agree that any claim arising out of or relating to your employment, its terms, or its end, including any statutory claim, will be resolved by final and binding arbitration administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised arbitration provider, on an individual basis only, and each of us waives any right to a jury trial and any right to participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to take any employment-related claim — including statutory claims — to court or before a jury, and gives up the right to join a class, collective or representative action. All claims must go through individual, final and binding arbitration, whose outcome is how the dispute ends.

flags.sourceSentence: Bonus awards are discretionary in amount and in whether they are made at all, and an award is paid only if you are employed on the payment date.
flags.consequence: The bonus is discretionary both in amount and in whether it is paid at all, and it is only paid if the signer is still employed on the payment date — so a signer who leaves (or is let go) just before the payment date receives nothing even for a full year of work.

flags.sourceSentence: If you resign or are terminated for cause within twelve (12) months of your start date, the full signing payment becomes repayable within thirty days of your last working day.
flags.consequence: If the signer resigns or is fired for cause within 12 months of the start date, the entire $15,000 signing payment must be repaid within 30 days of their last working day — even though the money was paid as an inducement to join.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator's total liability to the Occupant for any loss of or damage to stored property, however caused, including loss or damage caused by the Operator's own negligence, is limited to five thousand dollars ($5,000) unless the Occupant has declared a higher value on the Unit Schedule and paid the corresponding value protection fee.
flags.consequence: The occupant must maintain full-value insurance on everything stored and show evidence of it whenever asked; if they do not, they bear the entire risk of loss themselves, and the Operator's liability for loss or damage — including damage caused by the Operator's own negligence — is capped at $5,000 unless the occupant declared a higher value and paid a value protection fee.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant will indemnify, defend and hold the Operator harmless from every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense, including reasonable attorney fees, brought by any person and arising out of the Occupant's use of the unit or the premises, the property stored in the unit, or the acts of anyone the Occupant allows on to the premises.
flags.consequence: The occupant must pay the Operator's costs, including attorney fees, for any claim by any person arising from the occupant's use of the unit, the stored property, or the acts of anyone the occupant lets onto the premises — an open-ended obligation with no cap.

flags.sourceSentence: Gate hours, the rules posted in the office, and the terms of this Agreement may be changed by the Operator on notice posted at the facility and sent to the Occupant's last known email address, and the changed version applies to the Occupant from the first day of the month after it is posted.
flags.consequence: The Operator can unilaterally change the gate hours, the posted rules, and the terms of this agreement itself — including rent and other obligations — by posting notice at the facility and emailing the occupant's last known address, with the changes binding from the first day of the following month; there is no cap on what can be changed and no stated right to exit without penalty.

flags.sourceSentence: Where rent or any charge is unpaid, the Operator has a lien on all property stored in the unit and may deny the Occupant access, overlock the unit, and after the notice period the law requires, sell the contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed.
flags.consequence: Unpaid rent or charges give the Operator a lien on everything in the unit, letting it deny the occupant access, overlock the unit, and — after whatever notice period the law requires — sell the occupant's belongings and keep the proceeds to cover what is owed.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator may increase the monthly rent on not less than thirty (30) days written notice to the Occupant, and the increased rent is due on the first rent day falling after the notice period ends.
flags.consequence: The Operator can raise the monthly rent on 30 days' written notice, and the occupant's only alternative is to leave; there is no cap on the increase.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent not received by the sixth day of the month incurs the late charge shown in the Schedule of Charges posted in the ofﬁce and on the Harbour Road website, and each further notice the Operator is required to send about an unpaid balance incurs the administration charge shown in the same schedule.
flags.consequence: Late rent triggers a late charge, and every further notice the Operator sends about the unpaid balance adds another administration charge; the amounts are not in the agreement but in a Schedule of Charges posted in the office and on the website, so the occupant cannot see the figures from this document alone, and the charges can repeat with each notice.

flags.sourceSentence: After the initial term this Agreement continues on a month to month basis, each month renewing on the first day of the month without notice from either party, until it is ended as Section 8 describes.
flags.consequence: The agreement renews itself month to month without any fresh signature, so it does not end on its own; the occupant must give written notice at least ten days before the end of a month to stop it, and rent for the month they move out is not refunded.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator may enter the unit to inspect it, to repair the premises, or where the Operator reasonably believes the contents present a danger, and will leave notice of the entry in or on the unit.
flags.consequence: The Operator can enter the occupant's unit to inspect it or make repairs without the occupant present, leaving only a notice in or on the unit afterwards; the occupant's stored belongings are accessible to the Operator during such entry.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent already paid for the month in which the Occupant moves out is not refunded.
flags.consequence: Rent already paid for the month in which the occupant moves out is not refunded, so the occupant pays for days they will not use if they leave mid-month.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a twelve month promotional plan renews for a further twelve month term at the end of the term then running, at the standard rate for the plan rather than at the promotional rate, unless you tell us to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term.
flags.consequence: A twelve-month promotional plan automatically renews for another twelve-month term at the standard rate rather than the promotional rate unless the signer tells Cascade to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term, so missing that deadline commits the signer to a further year at a higher, stated-in-advance-but-unseen rate.

flags.sourceSentence: Cancelling a promotional plan before the end of its term does not cancel a device instalment plan, and the unpaid instalment balance becomes due in full on your next bill.
flags.consequence: Cancelling a promotional plan before its term ends does not end the device instalment plan, and the entire unpaid instalment balance becomes due in full on the next bill, which could be a large lump sum depending on the balance shown in documents the signer has not supplied.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade may change any term of this Agreement, any charge, and any feature of your rate plan, and the change takes effect on the date stated in the notice we give you, which may be given on a bill, by message to your device, or by email.
flags.consequence: Cascade can change any term of the agreement, any charge, and any feature of the rate plan, and the change takes effect on a date stated in a notice that can arrive on a bill, by device message, or by email. The clause names no cap on increases and no right to leave without penalty except the separate 30-day window for material increases to the monthly recurring charge.

flags.sourceSentence: Continuing to use the service after the effective date of a change accepts the change.
flags.consequence: The signer is treated as accepting any change Cascade makes simply by continuing to use the service after the effective date, so silence and ordinary use count as agreement to new terms or charges.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Cascade harmless from any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal fees, arising out of your use of the service, out of anything sent from or stored on your device, out of the use of your line by anyone you allow to use it, and out of any charge incurred on your account.
flags.consequence: The signer must cover any claim, loss or expense, including Cascade's reasonable legal fees, arising from use of the service, anything sent from or stored on the device, use of the line by anyone the signer allows, or any charge incurred on the account — an open-ended obligation with no cap, triggered even by other people's use of the line.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Cascade agree that any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, the service or any device will be resolved by individual binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer rules, and both of us give up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: Under the lease sentence, any dispute arising out of or relating to the agreement, the service or a device is to be resolved by individual binding arbitration before a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer rules, and both parties give up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action. So a problem affecting many customers could not be pursued as a group under this provision.

flags.sourceSentence: Your bill includes a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge, neither of which is a tax or a charge required by any government, and Cascade may introduce, increase or remove either charge on notice given with the bill in which the change ﬁrst appears.
flags.consequence: The bill carries a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge that are not government-required, and Cascade can introduce, increase or remove either at any time, with the notice being simply the bill in which the new amount first appears. The amounts sit in the bill or Rate and Charge Guide, which the signer has not supplied, so the size of the exposure is unknown and can grow over time.

flags.sourceSentence: An amount not paid by the due date shown on the bill incurs a late payment charge of the greater of five dollars ($5.00) or one and one half percent of the unpaid balance, applied each bill period until the balance is paid, and a restored line incurs the restoral charge shown in the Rate and Charge Guide.
flags.consequence: An unpaid balance incurs a late charge of the greater of $5.00 or 1.5% of the unpaid balance, applied again every bill period until the balance is paid, so the charge compounds on an ongoing dispute or hardship; a restored line also incurs a restoral charge whose amount sits in the Rate and Charge Guide the signer has not supplied.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade’s entire liability to you for any claim relating to the service, a device, or this Agreement, whether the claim is made in contract, in negligence, in warranty or under any statute, is limited to the service charges applied to the affected line during the bill period in which the claim arose, and Cascade is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or any indirect or consequential loss.
flags.consequence: Cascade's total liability for any claim about the service, a device, or the agreement is capped at the service charges for the affected line for the single bill period in which the claim arose, and it is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or indirect or consequential loss, so recovery for a serious problem is limited to roughly one month of line charges.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a monthly plan has no fixed term and continues from bill period to bill period until cancelled.
flags.consequence: Monthly plan service continues automatically from bill period to bill period until the signer cancels; it does not end on its own, so the signer must actively cancel to stop the billing.

flags.sourceSentence: Charges accrue to the end of the bill period in which you cancel, and a part bill period is not prorated.
flags.consequence: When the signer cancels, charges accrue to the end of the bill period and the part bill period is not prorated, so the signer pays for days of service they will not use after cancelling.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may amend the Programme Handbook, the assessment structure, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement at any time by issuing a revised version to the Analyst by email, and the revised version applies from the date of that email.
flags.consequence: The Firm can change the Handbook, the assessments, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement itself at any time, and the change takes effect simply by emailing it — including changes that alter pay-related terms, add obligations, or reduce what the Analyst was promised, with no cap, no consent requirement and no right to leave without penalty stated.

flags.sourceSentence: For six (6) months after the Programme ends, the Analyst will not accept an engagement, whether paid or unpaid and whether as an employee, a contractor or an intern, with any firm on the Restricted List issued to the Analyst in week one of the Programme, and will not approach any client of the Firm whose file the Analyst worked on.
flags.consequence: For six months after the Programme ends, the Analyst cannot take any engagement — paid or unpaid, employee, contractor or intern — with any firm on the Restricted List, and cannot approach any client whose file they worked on; the Restricted List is confidential, may be reissued during the Programme, and its contents are not shown in this document, so the scope of the bar is unknown at signing.

flags.sourceSentence: The Analyst will indemnify the Firm and hold it harmless against any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal costs, arising out of a breach by the Analyst of Section 4 or Section 5, or out of anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or a client of the Firm.
flags.consequence: The Analyst must pay for any claim, loss or expense the Firm incurs — including legal costs — arising from a breach of the confidentiality or non-compete sections, or from anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or its clients; the amount is open-ended and uncapped, and 'anything the Analyst publishes' is not limited to confidential material.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between the Analyst and the Firm arising out of the Programme or out of this Agreement will be resolved by final and binding arbitration on an individual basis, administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised provider, and the Analyst gives up any right to a jury trial and any right to bring or join a class or collective action.
flags.consequence: The Analyst gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class or collective action, and must resolve any dispute with the Firm through individual, final and binding arbitration instead of court.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may end the Programme early for any reason on one week written notice.
flags.consequence: The Firm can end the Programme at any time for any reason on one week's written notice, cutting off the remaining stipend weeks with no compensation, while the Analyst's own obligations (confidentiality, the six-month restriction) continue afterwards.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Analyst takes the optional housing advance, it is repaid in six equal instalments deducted from the stipend, and any instalment not recovered within ten (10) days of its due date carries the late charge set out in the Programme Handbook until it is repaid in full.
flags.consequence: If a housing advance repayment instalment is more than ten days late, a late charge set out in the Programme Handbook (an amount not shown in this document) applies and keeps accruing until the advance is repaid in full, on top of the six equal deductions already taken from the stipend.

flags.sourceSentence: An item not returned within five working days is charged at the replacement cost shown in the Programme Handbook.
flags.consequence: If the laptop, security token or building pass is not returned within five working days after the last day of the Programme, the Analyst is charged the replacement cost listed in the Programme Handbook — an amount not shown in this document.

flags.sourceSentence: After the third lesson no refund is made.
flags.consequence: If the signer gives up the place after the third lesson, they lose the entire $120 fee; between the first and third lesson they lose half of it, and within seven days of the first lesson they lose nothing only if they cancel early enough.
